title: Welcome and getting set up quiz

questions.question: An office manager gets a polished appointment email from Claude. What should happen next?

answers.feedback: The draft needs review before sending.

answers.text: Check its facts and tone against the request.
answers.feedback: Correct. Compare the facts and tone with the request before approval.

answers.text: Assume good grammar means the facts are correct.
answers.feedback: Good grammar does not prove accuracy.

questions.question: A colleague has Pro on their work email. What does that tell you?

answers.text: It is an individual subscription; work-data approval still needs checking.
answers.feedback: Correct. Pro is a personal plan, even on a work email address.

answers.text: It is automatically a Team workspace.
answers.feedback: A work email does not change the plan into Team.

answers.text: Every work document is approved for upload.
answers.feedback: The account does not grant approval to use every document.

questions.question: On a personal account, where is the model improvement setting checked?

answers.feedback: Projects is for related work and references.
Correct. Open Privacy and check Help Improve our AI models.
Artifact export does not control model improvement.

questions.question: Which statements are sound? Select all that apply.

answers.text: Paid plans can still have usage limits.
answers.feedback: Correct. More usage is not unlimited usage.

answers.text: Team needs at least two members.
answers.feedback: Correct. The official Team guide specifies at least two members.

answers.text: Turning model improvement off makes any data safe to upload.
answers.feedback: Privacy approval and data-handling checks are still required.

answers.text: Use invented information for the course exercises.
answers.feedback: Correct. Invented examples avoid using real private information.

questions.question: A manager wants to paste employee medical details into an incognito chat. What should you say?

answers.feedback: The organisation still has privacy obligations.

answers.text: Incognito is not approval; stop and follow the organisation’s data policy.
answers.feedback: Correct. Use the policy and privacy assessment before any real personal information.

answers.text: Incognito means no data is retained anywhere.
answers.feedback: Incognito is retained by the provider under its retention rules.
